premises: Fixed k≥2; m=4^t; lower bound eventually in t and circuit asymptotic from t≥1.

external_inputs: [6] Bansal-Sinha, Theorem 1.3 and Corollary 1.4 (checked against arXiv:2008.07003): randomized decision trees of error 1/3 for (2^{-5k},k)-Forrelation need Omega(k^{-29}(N/log(kN))^{1-1/k}) queries

inspection.type:
∀ (k : ℕ),
  2 ≤ k →
    (∃ t₀, ∀ (t : ℕ), t₀ ≤ t → QuarticQuery.Lvalue k t < QuarticQuery.R (QuarticQuery.P k t)) ∧
      (∃ A,
          0 < A ∧
            ∀ (t : ℕ) (η : ℝ),
              0 < η →
                η < 1 / 2 →
                  ∃ n L Z instZ,
                    have x := instZ;
                    ∃ o out F,
                      ↑(2 * (n * k)) ≤ A * (1 + Real.log (1 / η)) ∧
                        QuarticQuery.Upper.IsCirc (n * k) F ∧
                          (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (b : Bool),
                              L z b = QuarticQuery.Upper.lawOf ((F z) (QuarticQuery.Upper.rket o)) out b) ∧
                            (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)),
                                0 ≤ L z Bool.false ∧ 0 ≤ L z Bool.true ∧ L z Bool.false + L z Bool.true = 1) ∧
                              (∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t)) (b : Bool),
                                  QuarticQuery.P k t z = Option.some b → 1 - η ≤ L z b) ∧
                                ∃ instI,
                                  have x_1 := instI;
                                  ∃ w emb K,
                                    ∀ (next : QuarticQuery.AdaptiveProgram (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t) w),
                                      (K next).queryCap ≤ 2 * (n * k) + next.queryCap ∧
                                        ∀ (z : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.ForrelationCoord k t))
                                          (ψ : QuarticQuery.Upper.Reg Z) (b : Bool),
                                          (K next).outputMass z ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ψ) b =
                                            next.outputMass z ((QuarticQuery.Upper.clEmb emb) ((F z) ψ)) b) ∧
        ∃ S,
          0 < S ∧
            ∀ (t : ℕ),
              1 ≤ t →
                ∃ C,
                  QuarticQuery.CircuitRealises C (QuarticQuery.P k t) ∧
                    ↑C.size ≤ ↑S * ↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t) * Real.logb 2 ↑(QuarticQuery.mValue t) ^ 2

lean.note: One conjunction gives the eventually valid R bound; one retained-state coherent physical witness, accuracy and all-input output law with fixed-k logarithmic budget; and a uniformly bounded realizing circuit. The local proof of part (i) is alternative to the cited route.
